# ethereum-optimism/op-geth Daily Update (Jan 7, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on preparing for new L2 chains with the introduction of Karst and enabling Osaka on these new L2s. Discussions continued on several active issues, particularly around `op-supernode` functionality and acceptance test flakiness.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **New L2 Chain Support**: Two new pull requests were opened today. [#744](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/744) introduces Karst, a new L2 chain, and [#745](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/745) enables the Osaka feature specifically for Karst L2s.

## CLOSED ISSUES

## NEW ISSUES

## ACTIVE ISSUES

- **`op-supernode` Enhancements and Dependencies**: Discussions on several `op-supernode` related issues highlighted interdependencies. [#18651](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18651) (Report current verified L1 not current derived L1) and [#18667](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18667) (Ensure `superroot_atTimestamp` responses are consistent) both depend on interop support within the supernode, as noted by pauldowman. Similarly, [#18669](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18669) (Update vm-runner to use super node) requires a `syncStatus` API from the supernode.
- **Acceptance Test Improvements**: DeborahOlaboye expressed interest in working on [#16972](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/16972) to re-enable flaky acceptance tests. Additionally, crStiv offered to address [#18675](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18675), which concerns the `TestSequencerPreset` not supporting the Kona sequencer.
- **Rollup Config Field Generation**: DeborahOlaboye also volunteered to work on [#14816](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/14816), which addresses an issue where OPCM version 0.0.11 does not generate Pectra rollup config fields, specifically the new `chain_op_config` data structure.
